shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: Hold the left flipper in before you launch to arm the Super Skill Shot. How hard you plunge decides whether the ball traps on the right flipper, arrives live on the left, or comes across on a loop pass.

shots.name: N2O Boost
shots.notes: The far left N2O target. When the boost is ready it doubles scoring, which is the single biggest thing to check before you commit to a big shot.

shots.name: Far Left Standup
shots.notes: The first standup in from the N2O target. Part of the left-to-right shot order in Cruisin'.

shots.name: Left Ramp
shots.notes: The workhorse of the machine. It diverts to the cup during Burnout Multiball to spell letters, and it is where Drift style points are cashed.

shots.name: The Cup
shots.notes: Where the left ramp sends the ball during Burnout Multiball while you are spelling BURNOUT. Once the word is complete the ramp goes back to feeding the left flipper.

shots.name: Left Standup
shots.notes: The inner left standup, fourth in the Cruisin' order after the ramp.

shots.name: GEARS Drop Targets
shots.notes: Clearing a set of these advances you one gear. The three lamps in front of them are what the Super Skill Shot is aimed at.

shots.name: Standups Behind The Drops
shots.notes: Two targets sitting behind the drop bank. They are only reachable once the drops are down, and they are what gate gears five and six.

shots.name: The Scoop
shots.notes: Mode select and mode start. Also where Drift, Silverball Stampede, Mustang Multiball, Upgrade Scoring, Upgrade Multiball and the multiball add-a-ball are all started.

shots.name: Captive Ball
shots.notes: Four hits qualify Burnout Multiball. It is also the main jackpot during Burnout and the combo jackpot target off the left ramp.

shots.name: Right Standup
shots.notes: The right-side standup used in Cruisin', Stunt Driver and Rally Race.

shots.name: Right Orbit
shots.notes: The main right-hand shot. Paired with the left ramp for Police Pursuit's red light chase and for Burnout jackpots.

shots.name: RPM Targets
shots.notes: Three standups down the right side. Completing them lights the spinner for more and, far more importantly, makes each target hit worth two million on a long timer.

shots.name: Spinner
shots.notes: Lit for a higher value once the RPM targets are completed.

shots.name: Pop Bumpers
shots.notes: During Burnout Multiball a set number of bumper hits relights the jackpot sequence and raises the combo jackpot each time.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: One of the bottom lanes. Completing them all arms the add-a-ball at the scoop.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: Another bottom lane toward the add-a-ball.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Part of the bottom lane set.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: The last of the bottom lanes.

shots.name: Left Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds the scoop, captive ball, right standup and right orbit. Held in before the launch it arms the Super Skill Shot.

shots.name: Right Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds the left ramp, the left standups and the N2O target. The plunge that leaves you trapped here is the easiest route into a clean Super Skill Shot.

goals.title: Super Skill Shot — Gears A Target
goals.summary: Hold the left flipper in before you launch, trap up, and take the A while its sweeping lamp is lit — the premium pick of the two Super Skill Shot awards.
goals.reward: 1M for GE or RS, 2M at the scoop, or two gears

steps.detail: Bring the ball down to the flippers — the skill shot is made with a flipper.

steps.action: Hold-launch, trap up, then take the A when its lamp is lit
steps.detail: Three lamps sweep across GE, A and RS in front of the gears targets. Land the A while lit for the Super Skill Shot award.

goals.title: Super Skill Shot — Scoop
goals.summary: The same hold-the-flipper launch, cashed at the scoop instead: a flat two million whenever the trap-up feels safer than timing the sweeping A lamp.

steps.detail: Bring the ball down to the flippers — the skill shot is made with a flipper.

steps.action: Hold-launch, trap up, then shoot the scoop
steps.detail: A guaranteed two million — the consistent alternative to timing the gears lamp.

goals.title: Gear Shift Multiball
goals.summary: You start in first gear and every completed set of drop targets shifts you up one. Each gear has its own multiball, and once you have played a gear's multiball you can never play that one again — so the gear you start in matters.
goals.reward: A different multiball at every gear

steps.action: Clear a set of drops to shift up
steps.detail: Straightforward all the way to gear four.

steps.action: Beat the clock for gear five
steps.detail: Clear all the drops, then hit one of the two standups behind them within five seconds.

steps.action: Do it twice for gear six
steps.detail: Clear the drops, hit one standup inside five seconds, then the other within another five.
Start in third and your next multiball has to be four, five or six. Start in sixth and you have to come back down to three, four or five.

goals.title: The Gear Super Jackpot
goals.summary: The super jackpot value is the sum of every gear up to the one you are in, which is why gear six is worth chasing. Gear four pays ten million; gear six normally pays twenty-one, but the very first gear six super is boosted to fifty.
goals.reward: 10M at gear four, 50M for the first gear six super

steps.detail: Any drop target or mini-jackpot shot lights it, and the timer on that first one is generous.

steps.action: Check N2O before you cash it
steps.detail: The first super has enough time on it to go and set up double scoring first. That is the difference between a good multiball and a great one.
A number of jackpots from the drops, the orbit or captive ball hits brings the super back.

goals.title: Cruisin'
goals.summary: The only mode that takes two visits to finish. The first pass wants every shot once, and taking them left to right doubles each one. The second pass wants the first four in strict order and then a roving light that speeds up each time you catch it.
goals.reward: Doubled shots for going left to right

steps.detail: N2O boost, far left standup, left ramp, left standup, scoop, captive ball, right standup, right orbit. In that order everything doubles.

steps.action: Come back and select it again
steps.detail: Completing the first pass does not finish the mode — you have to restart it from the scoop.

steps.action: Take the first four in order
steps.detail: N2O target, far left standup, left ramp, left standup, no substitutions.

steps.action: Catch the roving light four times
steps.detail: It moves faster with each one you hit. Four catches completes the mode.

goals.title: Road Course
goals.summary: A timed race across six lit shots — all the N2O targets, the left ramp, the captive ball and the right orbit. The first four you make advance your position, and then the two you did not use become the only shots that count.

steps.action: Make any four of the six
steps.detail: Each of the first four advances you up the field.
Whichever two you did not hit stay lit, and you need four more hits between them in any combination.

steps.action: Take the scoop to finish first
steps.detail: The scoop is what actually ends the race and lights the mode solid.

goals.title: Police Pursuit
goals.summary: The least demanding of the top row by a distance. Six shots light, three on each side, and you have to alternate sides to reach yellow light. Then four shots light for red light, and then it becomes a straight chase.
goals.reward: Mode lit solid in eight shots

steps.detail: Hitting a shot on one side forces your next one to be on the other.

steps.action: Any of four for red light
steps.detail: Two shots light on each side; one hit is all it takes.
Right orbit twice, then left ramp twice, and you are away. Eight shots in total.

goals.title: Stunt Driver
goals.summary: A loosely timed mode with a short shot sequence. Take the shots in order and it is over quickly; miss the order and you end up doing repeated takes to get through it.
goals.reward: Fast completion for a clean sequence

steps.detail: That is the first shot of the sequence.
The third shot is the left ramp again or the right orbit, whichever you can reach.
The right orbit, the captive ball or the right standup all close it out.

goals.title: Drag Race
goals.summary: The mode that doubles as a gear ladder. Five hits on the standup targets pushes you up to gear six and starts the drag race multiball, and the mode is only marked complete once you are back down to a single ball.

steps.detail: That advance takes you to gear six.
Drag race multiball starts automatically at the top of the ladder.

steps.action: Know what your shots are worth
steps.detail: A completed RPM bank pays two million a target, which is more than the drag race super jackpot — so RPM scoring can outweigh the multiball itself.

goals.title: Rally Race
goals.summary: Left side, right side, right side again, and then the mode hands you a shortcut at the left ramp. Take it and you go straight on to two more left ramps and the N2O boost; miss it and you have to hit the captive ball before you can carry on.
goals.reward: A shorter route for hitting the shortcut

steps.detail: The left ramp or an N2O standup both count as your left-side shot.
The orbit or a standup, then the standup or the captive ball.

steps.action: Take the shortcut when it lights
steps.detail: Hit it and you only need two more left ramps and a hard left at the N2O boost. Miss it and the captive ball has to be hit before you can carry on.

steps.action: Close it at the N2O boost
steps.detail: The far left boost target ends the mode either way.

goals.title: Starting and Finishing All Six
goals.summary: There are two separate thresholds here and it is worth knowing the difference. Merely starting all six modes prepares Drift at the scoop; actually lighting all six solid — which means finishing them — prepares Silverball Stampede.
instructions: Starting all six modes is enough to prepare Drift at the scoop, so a bad game can still reach it.
Lighting all six solid is a much taller order and is what prepares Silverball Stampede at the scoop.
Cruisin' is the awkward one — it is the only mode that has to be started twice before it will light solid.
Police Pursuit is the cheapest of the top three to finish at only eight shots, so take it early to build momentum.
Finishing any of the top three modes can also hand you a Mystery Ford award, which is a second route to qualifying Burnout Multiball.

goals.title: Burnout Multiball
goals.summary: Qualified by four hits on the captive ball. It opens with three 200,000 jackpots at the left ramp, captive ball and right orbit, and one of them lights the main jackpot at the captive ball for ten million.
goals.reward: 10M main jackpot, 20M and up on combos

steps.action: Four captive ball hits to qualify
steps.detail: A Mystery Ford award, handed out when you finish one of the top three modes, can also qualify it.
While the letters are outstanding the left ramp diverts into the cup instead of returning to the flipper.
Once BURNOUT is complete the ramp feeds the left flipper again, setting up a 20 million combo into the captive ball.
A set number of bumper hits restarts the whole sequence, adding 20 million to the combo jackpot and 5 million to the regular one each time.

goals.title: Mustang Multiball
goals.summary: Spell MUSTANG from completed modes and Mystery Ford awards to light the scoop, then start it whenever single-ball play suits you. Four balls, and every major yellow arrow shot is lit for a jackpot.

steps.action: Spell MUSTANG, then choose your moment
steps.detail: The scoop stays lit, so you can hold it until the playfield is set up the way you want.
Collecting one shot switches all the others off and lights the one you just made for a double.

steps.action: Repeat the same shot for the double
steps.detail: Taking the double relights everything except that shot, so the pattern is: new shot, same shot, new shot, same shot.

goals.title: RPM Scoring
goals.summary: The most lopsided scoring on the machine. Complete the three right-side standups and every hit to that bank becomes worth two million — four million with N2O running — which outscores most of the multiballs outright.

steps.detail: This also lights the spinner for a higher value, though that is the smaller part of the reward.
Double scoring takes each target to four million.
All three RPM lamps flash, then drop to two, then one before it times out. Hitting the bank again restarts a long timer.

goals.title: N2O Double Scoring
goals.summary: The far left N2O target arms a double-scoring boost. It is the cheapest multiplier in the game and the habit worth building is simple: before any big collect, check whether N2O is ready.

steps.detail: The far left target is awkward from a moving ball, so take it from a trapped right flipper.

steps.action: Spend it on the RPM bank
steps.detail: Four million a target is the highest per-shot rate available.
The first gear super jackpot has enough time on its timer to go and set N2O up first.

goals.title: Drift
goals.summary: Prepared at the scoop once you have started all six modes. It is a single-ball round with a long ball save: hit lit shots to build style points, then cash the total at the left ramp. Every shot you hit goes dark and relights when you collect.
goals.reward: Style points collected at the left ramp

steps.action: Start all six modes, then take the scoop
steps.detail: You only have to start them, not finish them.

steps.action: Build style points on lit shots
steps.detail: Any lit playfield shot adds to the pot and then goes dark.

steps.action: Bank it at the left ramp
steps.detail: Collecting relights everything you had already used, so the round runs in build-and-cash cycles.

goals.title: Silverball Stampede
goals.summary: The deepest thing on the machine. Lighting all six modes solid — genuinely finishing them, not just starting them — prepares Silverball Stampede at the scoop. Getting there is the achievement; almost nobody sees it on location.

steps.detail: Cruisin' needs two starts, so budget for that. Police Pursuit is the quickest to bank.
Drift is prepared by starting all six; the Stampede needs all six lit solid.

goals.title: The Upgrades
goals.summary: A separate track from the modes. Completing all of the playfield Upgrades once lights the scoop for Upgrade Scoring, and completing them a second time lights it for Upgrade Multiball.
instructions: Complete every Upgrade on the playfield once and the scoop lights for Upgrade Scoring.
Complete the whole set a second time and the scoop lights for Upgrade Multiball instead.
Both are started at the scoop, so they compete with mode starts, Drift and Mustang Multiball for the same shot — plan which one you want lit when you get there.
Because everything funnels through one scoop, a game with several awards queued can waste them; take the cheapest ones off the stack first.

goals.title: Mystery Ford Awards
goals.summary: Finishing one of the top three modes can hand you a Mystery Ford award. It is the game's shortcut currency — it can qualify Burnout Multiball outright and it spells letters in MUSTANG toward the four-ball multiball.

steps.detail: Police Pursuit is the least demanding of them at only eight shots.

steps.action: Take Qualify Burnout when it lands
steps.detail: That saves you four captive ball hits.
Letters come from completed modes and from these awards, and spelling the word lights the scoop for the four-ball multiball.

goals.title: Multiball Add-A-Ball
goals.summary: Simple and easy to forget in the middle of a multiball. Complete the bottom lanes, then shoot the scoop, and you get another ball. Worth setting up before you start a multiball rather than during one.

steps.detail: The inlanes and outlanes across the bottom of the playfield.
The extra ball arrives immediately, which also buys you time to reset.

achievements.title: Two Gears At Once
achievements.desc: Land the A on the Super Skill Shot to jump two gears.

achievements.title: Top Gear
achievements.desc: Chain the drops and both standups to reach gear six.

achievements.title: Fifty Million
achievements.desc: Collect the boosted first super jackpot in gear six.

achievements.title: Red Light
achievements.desc: Complete Police Pursuit and light it solid.

achievements.title: Twice Round
achievements.desc: Start Cruisin' a second time and complete the roving shots.

achievements.title: Spell Burnout
achievements.desc: Complete BURNOUT at the cup during Burnout Multiball.

achievements.title: Combo Jackpot
achievements.desc: Take the 20 million left ramp to captive ball combo.

achievements.title: Four Balls
achievements.desc: Spell MUSTANG and start the four-ball multiball.

achievements.title: Four Million A Hit
achievements.desc: Run RPM scoring with the N2O boost active.

achievements.title: Drift
achievements.desc: Start all six modes and reach Drift at the scoop.

achievements.title: Silverball Stampede
achievements.desc: Light all six modes solid and reach the final scoop award.

achievements.title: Fully Upgraded
achievements.desc: Complete the playfield Upgrades twice to light Upgrade Multiball.

drills.title: Hold-Launch And Trap
drills.text: Hold the left flipper in before you launch and plunge so the ball comes down trapped on the right flipper — that trap is what makes the shot, not the plunge. Take the A while its sweeping lamp is lit, and when the sweep will not cooperate, take the flat two million at the scoop instead of forcing it.

drills.title: Beat The Five-Second Clock
drills.text: Gears one through four come free with the drops, but five and six do not: clear the bank, then hit one of the two standups behind it within five seconds, then the other within another five. Drill the follow-up shot on its own, because the drops are never the part that fails.

drills.title: Live On The RPM Bank
drills.text: Complete the three right-side standups and every further hit on that bank is worth two million, or four with N2O running — more per shot than anything else on the machine. Watch the lamps fade from three to two to one and hit the bank again before the timer dies rather than letting it lapse.
drills.reps: one full ball with the bank kept alive

drills.title: N2O From The Cradle
drills.text: The far left N2O target is awkward from a moving ball, so cradle on the right flipper and take it deliberately. Build the habit of checking N2O before any big collect — the first gear super jackpot has enough time on its timer for you to go and arm double scoring first.

drills.title: Cruisin' Left To Right
drills.text: The first pass doubles every shot if you take them strictly left to right: N2O boost, far left standup, left ramp, left standup, scoop, captive ball, right standup, right orbit. Run it as one lap rather than a shot list, and remember the mode is not finished until you go back and select it a second time.

drills.title: Ramp Into The Captive
drills.text: While BURNOUT is still outstanding the left ramp diverts into the cup and never comes back to your flipper. Once the word is complete the ramp feeds the left flipper again, and that return is the combo — ramp, then straight into the captive ball for the twenty million.

actionButton.label: Action Button
actionButton.location: centre of the lockdown bar, on Premium (Boss) and LE cabinets
actionButton.how: Mustang's button is about races: it starts them, it brings them back after a drain, and once you have banked a Powershift it spends one for free progress. It lights up and blinks when the machine wants you to use it, so watch the middle of the bar during race select. Pro cabinets ship without it, and their bar is blank.

uses.what: Flippers scroll through the six races; the button locks in the one you want and sends you into it.
Press it to pick the race back up rather than starting your next ball with nothing running.

uses.when: Holding a Powershift during a race
uses.what: Spends one for a race shot award. Powershifts come from the sneak-in skill shot and from the caution targets.
That blink means the machine is waiting on your pick and will not move on until you press.

howItPlays.objective: Mustang is a Stern muscle-car game: pick one race at a time, shift up a six-speed gear ladder for a different multiball at every gear, and lean on the RPM bank and the N2O boost for the fastest points. Start all six races to prepare Drift, and finish all six to unlock the rarely seen Silverball Stampede.
loop: Pick a race at the scoop -- on Boss and LE cabinets you scroll the six with the flipper buttons and lock your choice with the lit action button -- then drop into it.
Clear the GEARS drop bank to shift up a gear; each gear hands you its own multiball, and a gear you have already run is gone for the rest of the game.
Complete the three RPM targets so the bank pays two million a hit, and arm the far-left N2O target to double that.
Bank finished races and Mystery Ford awards to spell MUSTANG for the four-ball multiball, and rattle the captive ball four times to load Burnout.
Start every race to light Drift at the scoop; light them all solid to reach Silverball Stampede.

lights.name: Gear Ladder
lights.lit: First gear is where every ball begins and a lit rung marks the gear you are in now; clearing a drop bank climbs you one, and the gear you reach holds until you cash its multiball.
lights.then: Gears one through four fall straight out of the drops, but five and six add a follow-up -- clear the bank, then beat a five-second clock to a standup behind it, twice over for six. Every gear owns a one-time multiball, and the gear super jackpot totals every gear below you, so gear six pays most and the game's first gear-six super is bumped to fifty million.

lights.name: RPM Targets
lights.lit: The three standups down the right side stay lit until the bank is done, and finishing it makes every later hit there pay two million for a long stretch while lighting the spinner for extra.
lights.then: This is the richest shot on the machine, more per hit than most of its multiballs, so keep the bank alive as its three lamps drop away one by one, since another hit there restarts the long window. Stack the N2O boost and each target jumps to four million.

lights.name: N2O Double Scoring
lights.lit: When the far-left N2O target is lit and ready it arms double scoring, the cheapest multiplier on the machine.
lights.then: Take it from a cradled right flipper, since the target is awkward on the move, and build the habit of arming it before any big collect. Spend the double on the RPM bank for four million a hit, or on a fresh gear super whose timer leaves room to set it up first.

lights.name: MUSTANG at the Scoop
lights.lit: Each letter of MUSTANG lights as you bank it, spelled by a finished race or a Mystery Ford award, and the letters hold rather than falling off so you chip the word together across the game.
lights.then: Complete the word and the scoop lights a four-ball multiball, and because the scoop holds its light you can wait until the playfield suits you. In it every yellow arrow is a jackpot -- take one and it shuts the others off and relights that arrow for double, so you alternate a new arrow with the same one doubled.

lights.name: Races at the Scoop
lights.lit: The scoop is the hub -- it selects and starts your race and is also where Drift, Silverball Stampede, and the two Upgrade awards queue when ready -- so a lit scoop means something is waiting to be started there.
lights.then: Scroll the six with the flipper buttons and lock your pick with the blinking action button on Boss and LE, or simply take the scoop on a Pro to start what is queued. Starting all six races preps Drift, lighting all six solid preps the far deeper Silverball Stampede, and running the Upgrade set once then twice preps Upgrade Scoring and Upgrade Multiball -- so clear the cheap awards off the stack first.

lights.name: Burnout Multiball
lights.lit: Four whacks on the captive ball light Burnout Multiball at it, or a Mystery Ford award can light it outright, and during Burnout the left ramp stops feeding your flipper and diverts into the cup while BURNOUT is unspelled.
lights.then: Spell BURNOUT at the cup and the ramp returns to your left flipper, teeing up a twenty-million combo straight back into the captive ball. A run of pop-bumper hits restarts the whole jackpot sequence, adding to that combo each time.

lights.name: Bottom Lanes
lights.lit: The four lanes across the bottom light as you roll them and an unlit one is still needed, but they do not shuffle when you press a flipper -- you complete the set simply by rolling the ones you are missing.
lights.then: Finish all four and the scoop is armed for a multiball add-a-ball, so bank the lanes before a multiball begins instead of fishing for them mid-multiball. The moment you then hit the lit scoop, another ball joins the game.

scoring.text: Grab the safe, repeatable points first. Take the Super Skill Shot by holding the left flipper before you launch, complete the RPM bank so it pays two million a hit, and get in the habit of arming N2O before every big shot.

Shift up the gear ladder for its stack of one-time multiballs, spell MUSTANG for the four-ball, and rattle the captive ball to qualify Burnout. Meanwhile keep starting races, since each one you begin edges you toward Drift.

Start all six races to reach Drift, then light every race solid for Silverball Stampede, the deepest award on the machine. The single biggest number, though, is the first gear-six super jackpot, bumped to fifty million.
